column10: The C-binary comparison skips where the binary is not built.
No criterion yet separates a genuine multiphase optimum from a stuck fit (#589).
The default-start test fixes the shapes at SAS's values, so only the coefficients start from defaults.
SAS parity covers fractional weights; weights beside repeated events are untested (#681).
Parity runs only with the study volume; the SAS targets are not yet set (#681).

Named as under-tested at the 2026-10-29 review. The epoch tests check that splitting a row into epochs leaves the log-likelihood unchanged. Production time-varying covariate work is under way in the Hsich and COMMENCE studies; none of it is in the test suite yet.
Single-distribution false maxima warn (#531); the multiphase criterion is open (#589).
